ability.viltrumitecore.block.name: <lime>Block
ability.viltrumitecore.block.desc:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>3s
<grey>Duration: <lime>2s (Max)
<grey>Type: <yellow>Toggle

<grey>Raise your guard to defend against incoming frontal attacks.
<grey>Absorbs <lime>70%<grey> of all damage taken from the direction
<grey>you are facing.

<red>Cannot be used while trying to grab, dashing, punching or chopping.

<blue>Viltrumite Core
ability.viltrumitecore.grab.name: <yellow>Grab & Carry
ability.viltrumitecore.grab.desc:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>-
<grey>Type: <yellow>Toggle

<grey>Grab a living entity standing right in front of you
<grey>by the throat and carry them through the air.

<grey>Toggle the ability again to release the target.
<grey>Your grip will automatically break if the target
<grey>damages you or if you deal damage to them.

<red>Cannot be activated while blocking.

<blue>Viltrumite Core
ability.viltrumitecore.lock.name: <yellow>Target Lock
ability.viltrumitecore.lock.desc:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>-
<grey>Type: <yellow>Toggle

<grey>Lock your focus onto a living target and
<grey>track their every move without looking away.

<grey>The lock will automatically disable if the target moves
<grey>too far away or breaks line of sight behind a wall.
<grey>You cannot lock onto an entity you are currently grabbing.

<blue>Viltrumite Core
ability.viltrumitecore.chop.name: <yellow>Lethal Chop
ability.viltrumitecore.chop.desc:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>-
<grey>Type: <aqua>Instant

<grey>Use your arms like a sharp blade to slice your enemies.
<grey>This strike deals <lime>175%<grey> of your base attack damage instantly.

<grey>The deep wound leaves the target bleeding for <lime>4 seconds<grey>.
<grey>They will take an additional <lime>175%<grey> damage over time
<grey>which equals to <lime>43.75%<grey> damage every second.

<blue>Viltrumite Core
ability.viltrumitecore.punch.name: <yellow>Sonic Punch
ability.viltrumitecore.punch.desc:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>1s
<grey>Type: <aqua>Instant

<grey>Throw a strong punch that deals <lime>200%<grey> of your base attack damage.
<grey>If you strike while flying this damage can scale up to <lime>500%<grey>.

<grey>The force of the punch creates a devastating shockwave
<grey>which instantly breaks blocks in a huge cone ahead of you.
<grey>Any enemy caught in the blast will be launched like a meteor.

<blue>Viltrumite Core
ability.viltrumitecore.thunderclap.name: <yellow>Thunderclap
ability.viltrumitecore.thunderclap.desc:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>-
<grey>Type: <aqua>Instant

<grey>Slam your hands together with catastrophic force
<grey>creating a massive cone-shaped shockwave.

<grey>The shockwave tears through the ground and
<grey>launches targets caught inside high into the air.

<blue>Viltrumite Core
ability.viltrumitecore.barrage.name: <yellow>Barrage
ability.viltrumitecore.barrage.desc:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>4s
<grey>Duration: <lime>4s (Max)
<grey>Type: <red>Hold

<grey>Hold down the key to unleash a relentless
<grey>series of rapid punches on your enemies.

<red>Cannot be used while blocking.

<blue>Viltrumite Core
ability.viltrumitecore.speed_lock.name: <blue>Speed Lock
ability.viltrumitecore.speed_lock.desc:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>-
<grey>Type: <yellow>Toggle

<grey>While in cruise flight press the sneak key to
<grey>lock your current flying speed.

<grey>You must be flying faster than <lime>20%<grey> of your
<grey>maximum speed to activate this ability.

<grey>This allows you to maintain a steady velocity
<grey>without needing to hold any additional keys.

<blue>Viltrumite Flight
ability.viltrumitecore.fast_takeoff.name: <blue>Fast Take-Off
ability.viltrumitecore.fast_takeoff.desc:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>-
<grey>Type: <aqua>Instant

<grey>Press Sneak and Double Jump to instantly
<grey>launch yourself high into the sky.

<blue>Viltrumite Flight
ability.viltrumitecore.supersonic_flight:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>-
<grey>Type: <red>Hold

<grey>While hovering in the air hold the sprint key to
<grey>transition into a fast horizontal flight.

<grey>Once you reach <lime>60%<grey> of your maximum speed, it
<grey>allows you to fly through blocks in your path.
<grey>Flying for too long will cause you to overheat.

<grey>If used immediately after <blue>Dash<grey>, you will instantly
<grey>enter <yellow>Supersonic Flight<grey>.

<blue>Viltrumite Flight
ability.viltrumitecore.dash.name: <blue>Dash
ability.viltrumitecore.dash.desc:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>1s
<grey>Type: <aqua>Instant

<grey>Dash forward at extreme speed and smash
<grey>through blocks and enemies in your path.

<blue>Viltrumite Core
ability.viltrumitecore.speed.name: <blue>Super Speed
ability.viltrumitecore.speed.desc:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>-
<grey>Type: <yellow>Toggle

<grey>Gain immense movement speed while on the ground.

<red>Cannot be activated or used while flying.

<blue>Viltrumite Core
event.viltrumitecore.trio.warn: A Viltrumite squad will arrive in %s...
event.viltrumitecore.trio.start: Lucan, Vidor and Thula have arrived.
event.viltrumitecore.trio.end: The Viltrumite squad has been wiped out.
ability.viltrumitecore.lions_heart.name: <gold>Lion's Heart
ability.viltrumitecore.lions_heart.desc:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>5s / 30s
<grey>Type: <yellow>Toggle

<grey>Transform into an unbreakable lion. While the
<grey>heart beats you take no damage, cannot be
<grey>controlled, and freeze nearby projectiles.

<red>Overheating burns your own health.

<blue>Regulus
ability.viltrumitecore.debris_kick.name: <gold>Debris Kick
ability.viltrumitecore.debris_kick.desc:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>20s
<grey>Type: <yellow>Cast

<grey>Kick the ground: the earth in front of you is torn out
<grey>and hurled forward as flying blocks, with a shotgun
<grey>spray of shards. Shards hit for 2 each (up to 4 per
<grey>target) and smash through blocks.

<red>Madness: <grey>bigger crater, 1.5x shards that pierce further.

<blue>Regulus
ability.viltrumitecore.mania.name: <gold>Mania
ability.viltrumitecore.mania.desc:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>25s
<grey>Type: <yellow>Channel

<grey>Pull a target toward you for up to 6 seconds,
<grey>then hold it frozen in place. Releasing early
<grey>still applies the freeze.

<blue>Regulus
ability.viltrumitecore.greeds_embrace.de:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>35s
<grey>Type: <yellow>Cast

<grey>Summon a dome that locks victims inside for
<grey>4 seconds. Their damage is stored and paid
<grey>back when the dome lifts.

<blue>Regulus
ability.viltrumitecore.counter.name: <gold>Counter
ability.viltrumitecore.counter.desc:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>40s
<grey>Type: <yellow>Cast

<grey>Only during madness. Answer your attacker (or the
<grey>creature you look at): uppercut it into the sky, appear
<grey>behind it in the air and slam it down into a crater.

<blue>Regulus
message.viltrumitecore.lion.overheat: Lion's Heart is overheating! It will stop in 3 seconds.
message.viltrumitecore.lion.heart_lost: A heart burned out — Lion's Heart window shortened.
ability.viltrumitecore.regulus_punch.des:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>1s
<grey>Type: <aqua>Instant

<grey>A Viltrumite-grade punch empowered by your hearts.
<grey>Breaks blocks and launches enemies.

<red>Madness: <grey>1.5x damage and a frozen-air blade
<grey>that cuts through everything ahead.

<blue>Regulus
hud.viltrumitecore.homelander.fear: You feel someone's gaze on you
ability.viltrumitecore.homelander_lasers:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>-
<grey>Type: <yellow>Hold

<grey>Burn everything in your sight with two red beams.
<grey>Sets targets on fire and scorches walls.
<grey>Heats your eyes: overheat locks them for 3s.

<blue>Homelander
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>-
<grey>Type: <aqua>Toggle

<grey>See up to 8 nearest creatures through walls,
<grey>their health and the way to reach them.
<grey>Their steps get louder, the rest goes quiet.
<grey>Those you watch feel fear. Slowly heats your eyes.

<blue>Homelander
ability.viltrumitecore.homelander_roar.d:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>15s
<grey>Type: <aqua>Instant

<grey>A furious roar knocks back everyone
<grey>in front of you (12 blocks) and slows them for 3s.

<blue>Homelander
ability.viltrumitecore.ironman_suit.name: <gold>Suit
ability.viltrumitecore.ironman_suit.desc:
<grey>Type: <aqua>Toggle

<grey>Without armor: the Mark 50 nanosuit
<grey>flows out of the reactor (~1s).
<grey>In the nanosuit: the nanites return to the reactor.

<blue>Iron Man
hud.viltrumitecore.ironman.enter_front: Stand in front of the suit to step in
ability.viltrumitecore.ironman_unibeam.d:
<grey>Type: <aqua>Hold

<grey>The chest reactor charges (~1s),
<grey>then a thick beam pushes targets (up to 3s).
<grey>Burns marks, breaks only glass and leaves.
<grey>Blinds whoever is hit or looks into it.
<grey>Afterwards the core overheats (2s).
<red>The third overheat triggers the overdraft.

<blue>Iron Man
<grey>Type: <aqua>Hold

<grey>Shoulder flaps open (~0.5s).
<grey>Sweep the crosshair over enemies to mark up to 4.
<grey>Release: a fan of homing missiles.
<grey>No marks: they fly straight ahead.

<blue>Iron Man
ability.viltrumitecore.ironman_nano_arse:
<grey>Type: <aqua>Press

<grey>Forms a weapon on the right hand.
<grey>Press again: blade ↔ hammer.
<grey>Blade: LMB slash weakens armor.
<grey>Hammer: LMB heavy blow / ground slam,
<grey>RMB charged launch through soft blocks.
<grey>MMB: back to the repulsors.

<blue>Iron Man
hud.viltrumitecore.ironman.overheat_warn: JARVIS: Core overheated twice. One more and it goes critical.
hud.viltrumitecore.ironman.overdraft: JARVIS: Overdraft! The core cannot hold this.
hud.viltrumitecore.ironman.nano_lost: Nanites lost: %s s until the suit is ready
ability.viltrumitecore.ironman_scan.name: <gold>Scan
ability.viltrumitecore.ironman_scan.desc:
<grey>Type: <aqua>Toggle

<grey>Needs the helmet closed.
<grey>Press once: the creature in front of you
<grey>is locked and scanned by itself (~1.5s):
<grey>JARVIS shows its health, armor, effects,
<grey>resistances and weak spots.
<grey>The target stays highlighted for 10s.

<blue>Iron Man
ability.viltrumitecore.ironman_counterme:
<grey>Type: <aqua>Press

<grey>Fires a fan of flares.
<grey>Homing shots turn to the flares,
<grey>nearby mobs lose track of you (2s).
<grey>Bosses are not fooled.
<grey>Cooldown: 20s.

<blue>Iron Man
ability.viltrumitecore.ironman_helmet.de:
<grey>Type: <aqua>Toggle

<grey>Opens or closes the faceplate.
<grey>Closed: full HUD, JARVIS, scan, target marks.
<grey>Open: you see only the energy bar.
<grey>Closes by itself when you take a hit.

<blue>Iron Man
jarvis.viltrumitecore.suit_up: JARVIS: Suit online. All systems ready.

scan.viltrumitecore.regulus.lion_heart: Lion Heart: will rise again once after a lethal hit
scan.viltrumitecore.ironman.nano_armor: Nano armor: %s armor, %s toughness, %s%% knockback resistance

<grey>Type: <aqua>Press

<grey>Calls the Veronica pod: it falls from the sky
<grey>within 30 blocks (never into water), ~1 TNT.
<grey>Press again while it stands (up to 64 blocks):
<grey>the suit menu. The pod stays ~60 s.
<grey>Cooldown 3 min after it leaves.

<blue>Iron Man
mark.viltrumitecore.mark_7.name: Mark 7
mark.viltrumitecore.mark_7.desc:
<grey>RMB (via MMB) or slot 3: thin precise beam
<grey>from the forearms. One target, breaks shields.
mark.viltrumitecore.mark_42.name: Mark 42
mark.viltrumitecore.mark_42.desc:
<grey>The glove flies to the target, hits and returns.
<grey>Loses parts one by one as it breaks.
mark.viltrumitecore.mark_15.name: Mark 15 «Sneaky»
mark.viltrumitecore.mark_15.desc:
<grey>~8 s of refraction camo: mobs beyond 8 blocks
<grey>lose you, the first hit deals x2.
<grey>Hidden from focus and scans, silent flight.
mark.viltrumitecore.mark_39.name: Mark 39 «Starboost»
mark.viltrumitecore.mark_39.desc:
<grey>Back booster: instant dash to sonic speed
<grey>in any direction, also a vertical take-off.
<grey>Fastest mark, cheaper sonic, weaker weapons.
mark.viltrumitecore.mark_17.name: Mark 17 «Heartbreaker»
mark.viltrumitecore.mark_17.desc:
<grey>Three short strong Unibeam pulses, no overheat.
<grey>The normal Unibeam charges in 0.5 s.
mark.viltrumitecore.war_machine_mk2.name: War Machine Mk2
mark.viltrumitecore.war_machine_mk2.desc:
<grey>Hold: bursts at the crosshair target, energy
<grey>instead of ammo. Up to 8 missile marks.
<grey>Slower flight, sonic drains faster.
mark.viltrumitecore.iron_heart_mk3.name: Iron Heart Mk3
mark.viltrumitecore.iron_heart_mk3.desc:
<grey>Jump or dive into the ground: strong ring shockwave.
<grey>Most armor, barely pushed, stronger shield.
<grey>Slower flight.
gui.viltrumitecore.veronica.title: VERONICA — SUIT BAY
hud.viltrumitecore.ironman.veronica_busy: Wait until the suit is on
hud.viltrumitecore.ironman.hulkbuster_no: No room for the Hulkbuster here
gui.viltrumitecore.veronica.hulkbuster_d: Mark 48 over your suit: huge punches, jackhammer, grab and throw, jump slam, thruster hop. No flight.
death.attack.viltrumitecore.divine: %1$s was struck down by divine power
death.attack.viltrumitecore.divine.playe: %1$s was struck down by the divine power of %2$s
commands.viltrumitecore.divine.not_divin: %s is not a divine damage type
subtitles.viltrumitecore.reinhard_combo_: Reinhard's final blow shakes the air
ability.viltrumitecore.reinhard_light_pu: A quick jab: 4 damage and a light push. Never breaks blocks.
ability.viltrumitecore.reinhard_step_das: A flash step of 6 blocks in the direction you move (or look). Cooldown 1 s.
ability.viltrumitecore.reinhard_catch.de: Opens your palm for 0.5 s: arrows and tridents are caught into your inventory, other projectiles vanish. Cooldown 2 s.
ability.viltrumitecore.reinhard_fist_com: Press again for the next hit: 10, 10, then 16 with a shockwave. Pause for over 1 s and the chain starts over.
ability.viltrumitecore.reinhard_sky_kick: Tosses the target lightly and kicks it 60+ blocks into the sky: 20 damage. Cooldown 10 s.
ability.viltrumitecore.reinhard_grab_thr: Press to grab the target in front of you, press again to throw it ~120 blocks beyond the horizon: 15 damage. Cooldown 12 s.
ability.viltrumitecore.reinhard_dash_beh: Press to appear behind the creature under your crosshair (up to 24 blocks), facing its back. Needs a safe spot near it. Cooldown 3 s.
ability.viltrumitecore.reinhard_stomp.de: Press to slam the ground with your foot: 12 damage to everything within 8 blocks on the ground, pushed outward; the top layer of the ground cracks. Cooldown 8 s.
Press to raise the back of your hand for 1 s: every projectile that hits you flies back to its shooter at the same speed. Cooldown 4 s.

%1$s was erased by the holy blade of %2$s
commands.viltrumitecore.annihilate.succe: Reid strike: %s killed, %s blocked (absolute), %s immune (divine), %s skipped
ability.viltrumitecore.reinhard_reid.des: Draws the Dragon Sword Reid in a 6 s world event (he stands still). Drawn: Rain of Cuts and the strongest attacks unlock. Press again to sheathe (1 s). Returns to the sheath after 60 s without combat and when you leave Holy Sword.
chat.viltrumitecore.reinhard.reid_drawn: The Dragon Sword Reid is drawn
